sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, the league leaders, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00 in what looks a straightforward assignment on paper. Sandbach come into the match in excellent form, having won their last outing and posting five wins in their last six games overall, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 matches. Alsager are struggling near the bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and have lost their last five matches in a row, making them heavy underdogs in this fixture.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place on 20 points, host Dawley Town at home in a match that could see them close the gap on Sandbach if they win. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a meeting of sides pushing the top; Eccleshall sit fifth but have lost their last game, while AFC Bridgnorth suffered a rare defeat most recently. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in what pits fourth-place against tenth—a good chance for the Casuals to consolidate their position after a recent win. Foley Meir host Bilston Town, with Bilston (6th, 17 points) looking to maintain momentum from their last win. Crewe face a tough task against in-form Allscott Heath, who have won their last match, while New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a fixture between mid-table struggling sides. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town at home against the pointless league bottom side, and Shawbury United—themselves winless bar one recent win—face Barnton, who have recovered recently with a win. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a match between two of the division's poorest-performing sides, both searching for consistency.
